messages:
marta_product: Hey team — kicking off a quick sync on a proposed "compact telemetry" mode for the Console. Idea: a per-tenant toggle that strips request/response bodies from logs/metrics and only keeps minimal provenance (route, model, token_count, trace_id).

ajay_ingest: +1 for the concept. Primary win is storage/cost and reducing PII surface. How will this interact with our current per-route sampling?

marta_product: Good question. Proposal is: compact mode alters the default for all routes to `no-bodies`, but routes can opt into `bodies-on` via a route-level flag. Sampling still applies after that.

kevin_console: UX note — we need to make the consequences obvious. If a route is `bodies-on` then debug/inspect can show full req/res, otherwise show a sanitized summary and a reason. Also provide a clear toggle with a confirmation modal and link to audit logs.

samir_sre: Operationally, we need a breakglass path for incidents. Suggest a time-limited, audited bypass token: when used it logs who unredacted and for how long.

lauren_privacy: From privacy/legal side: we must default to compact for all enterprise customers until they opt-in. Also require a signed business justification for persistent `bodies-on` at tenant level. Emergency breakglass is fine but should be ephemeral and recorded.

ajay_ingest: Implementation sketch: add a header `x-redwood-telemetry-mode: compact|full` set by the control plane. In compact mode the ingest pipeline drops `request.body` and `response.body` fields before writing to s3/elasticsearch.

kevin_console: Example config in JSON for the console toggle would help; quick draft:```json
{
  "telemetry_mode": "compact", // compact|full
  "route_overrides": {
    "/debug/*": "full",
    "/user-upload": "compact"
  }
}
```

marta_product: Nice. Two follow-ups: 1) metrics — even in compact mode we still emit `tokens_generated` and `latency_ms` per request. 2) Can we keep searchable fake-snippets (first 16 bytes hash) to aid dedupe without exposing content?

lauren_privacy: Hashing is OK if irreversible and salted per-tenant. No partial plaintext. Make salt rotation possible. Also document that hashed snippets are considered telemetry and included in DSR/subject access requests per policy.

samir_sre: For tracing, we keep `trace_id` and span metadata. That should let us triage without bodies in most cases. But some incidents will require bodies — breakglass flow must auto-create a case in the audit tracker and notify security on slack (ops-bot).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary release scheduled: compact-mode flag backend toggles in `staging` at 2025-10-12T18:00Z. :rocket:

ajay_ingest: Rollout plan idea: 1) add header + pipeline drop in staging; 2) enable tenant-level toggle in Console UI (hidden behind feature flag); 3) run opt-in tests with two pilots; 4) open for GA as default.

kevin_console: Instrumentation for the Console: show estimated storage and cost delta if tenant toggles from compact->full. Also show a compliance checkbox and link to policy.

marta_product: Risk/edgecases: - routes that do client-side encryption: if encrypting bodies, compact/full semantics should not attempt to introspect. - streaming requests: need to truncate/obfuscate prefix rather than drop entirely?

ajay_ingest: For streaming we can keep metadata and the final `token_count`. Maybe keep a 32-byte prefix hash if tenant is full-opted. Otherwise drop.

lauren_privacy: Also we need retention alignment: compact-mode telemetry can have longer retention for aggregated metrics but shorter for any snippets/hashes. Document defaults: aggregated metrics 13 months, raw bodies 30 days (if opted-in), hashed-snippets 6 months.

samir_sre: Alerting: create an oncall policy that if breakglass is used, a high-severity pager triggers. Too many unredact events in a short window = security incident.

marta_product: Sounds like consensus. Action items: @ajay add pipeline feature branch + docs, @kevin mock Console toggle and cost estimate widget, @lauren draft legal opt-in template, @samir wire up breakglass audit+pager.

kevin_console: I'll post a mock screenshot later today.

ajay_ingest: Putting a PR up now for header and drop logic, reference branch `feature/compact-telemetry`.

lauren_privacy: I'll start the justification template and include DSR notes.

samir_sre: I'll stub the oncall runbook and breakglass audit flow.

marta_product: Great. Wrapping up — can we reconvene Friday 16:00 UTC after initial mocks? :thumbsup:

kevin_console: Works for me.

ajay_ingest: Works.

lauren_privacy: Works.

samir_sre: Will be there.

ops-bot: reminder-bot: Meeting scheduled: Feature sync — Compact Telemetry — Fri 16:00 UTC.
